display.purpose: A genuine live transfer metric only.

title.purpose: Device names and primary row headings.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A 44px native action using the shared primary semantic role.
components.css: .ds-mobile-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(170.1 79.7% 31.2%); color: hsl(222.2 84% 4.9%); font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mobile-primary:active { opacity: .7; } .ds-mobile-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(15 143 122 / .45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Device Row
components.description: A compact touch-first expression of the shared device-card contract.
components.css: .ds-device-row { min-height: 76px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid hsl(161.5 23.6% 89.2%); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(156 33.3% 97.1%); color: hsl(222.2 84% 4.9%); font: 600 15px system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Touch-first and interruption-tolerant, while inheriting the same trusted-device language as desktop and Web. Native clarity, safe areas, and explicit actions take precedence over desktop material effects.

rules.name: The Native Adaptation Rule
rules.body: Native input and safe-area behavior adapt the root contract; they do not create a second visual world.

dos: Do prefer native sheets and touch feedback.
Do preserve root state and trust mappings.
donts: Don't restore a blue primary or collaborator-green trust mapping.
Don't silently touch the clipboard or auto-retry after relaunch.
